title: ‘Moulin Rouge! The Musical’ to make Manila debut in May 2027
summary: The Tony Award-winning musical “Moulin Rouge!” will make its Manila debut from May 4 to May 30, 2027, at The Theatre at Solaire, GMG Productions announced Wednesday.
